traits.wood_modulus_green_mpa.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), table 5-3a, Spruce, Sitka, green: modulus of elasticity 8,500 MPa in static bending (clear wood, centre-loaded, span 14 depths; specific gravity 0.37).

traits.wood_rupture_green_mpa.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), table 5-3a, Spruce, Sitka, green: modulus of rupture 39,000 kPa (clear wood in static bending).

traits.wood_moisture_green_share.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), table 4-1, Spruce, Sitka: average moisture content of green wood, heartwood 41% and sapwood 142% of oven-dry mass; stated as a share, the range between them with its middle typical where both are given.

traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 species aggregate for Picea sitchensis (gwddagg_v2.2_species.csv, read): specific gravity 0.38 (wsg_est, the database's hierarchical-model species mean, from 13 records in 7 sources); trunks 0.38, branches 0.48. Basic density (oven-dry mass over green volume) is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, p. 62): needles 15 to 25 mm, sharp, spreading from all sides of the twig; seed cones narrowly oblong-oval, 6 to 10 cm, their thin toothed scales twice as long as the bracts.

traits.cone_length_m.note: Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, p. 62): needles 15 to 25 mm, sharp, spreading from all sides of the twig; seed cones narrowly oblong-oval, 6 to 10 cm, their thin toothed scales twice as long as the bracts.

traits.juvenile_period_years.note: FEIS (Griffith 1992, read): sexual maturity varies from 20 to 40 years. The Woody Plant Seed Manual (Picea, table 2, read): minimum seed-bearing age 20. It sets adult_age through the rule at the seed plants (spec rework P6), in place of the 20 years set by hand.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a massive conifer with a broad, buttressed base, level branches with hanging branchlets and stiff, sharp needles all round the twigs; fast-growing on wet ground near the coast. Not fitted to measurements. Cones (plant forms F3): 5 to 10 cm hang from the upper branches, papery scales; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Spec rework E6d: `cone_length`, `cone_pitch`, `needle_years` now set by the rules at Pinidae from the stated characters. Conifer form (pinidae revision 5): `branch_reach` fitted so the open-grown crown keeps revision 4's radius at the oldest keyframe.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 36 m tall and 60 cm across at breast height at 60 years in a closed stand. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: blue-green needles with silvery undersides; thin grey-brown bark in small scales. Needle shoots (plant roadmap P4): stiff, sharp needles 1.5 to 2.5 cm long and 1 to 1.5 mm wide, so a needle 0.06 as wide as it is long (`width`), from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): thin grey bark in small loose rounded scales; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Spec rework E6d: `needle`, `ranks` now set by the rules at Pinidae from the stated needles.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).
